[1/1] Plan: stack the docked drone card text and actions so no name, status or stat line clips

impact_assessment.why: At 1280x720 the drone card's three-column ledger grid leaves about a 103px text column: Mining Drone Alpha, MINING // SOL [HARVESTING] and the stats line all ellipsize, and a 16-tab sweep flags nine clipped text nodes in FLEET only.
impact_assessment.benefits: The docked drone card shows its full name, role/system/status and stats on full-width lines with REFIT and DISMISS beneath; the sweep reports zero clipped drone text and the wider layout is unchanged.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: FLEET drone roster at <=1599px; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: CSS only; regression: REFIT and DISMISS stay reachable, the card still shows yield and integrity, and the >1599px layout keeps its current grid.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Apply the reflow inside a max-width 1599px media query, rerun the tab sweep and FLEET browser capture, play a real refit, add a CSS contract test, and run full gates.

checkpoints.description: FLEET docked text verified: drone card stacks, escort rows wrap, 16-tab sweep clipped 9->0 with tiny 0/hscroll 0; checklists: passed
Task 'voidfarer-fleet-drone-legibility' completed successfully.
[1/1] Plan: let the SHIP interior status wrap instead of truncating at a 12em cap

impact_assessment.why: At 1920x1080 and 4K the SHIP interior header shows `CORVETTE SCOUT //...`, hiding the 3/6 staffing count because `.ship-interior-status` caps at 12em with nowrap and ellipsis; the 16-tab sweep flags it at both wide viewports.
impact_assessment.benefits: The ship class and staffing line stays fully readable at every supported viewport and the 1920/4K sweep reports zero clipped text.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: SHIP interior header at >1599px; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: CSS only; regression: the header must not overlap the SHIP ROOMS button or the panel edge, and the <=1599px hidden state stays unchanged.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Allow natural wrapping with no max-width, capture SHIP at 1920/4K, rerun the wide sweeps, add a CSS contract test, and run full gates.

checkpoints.description: SHIP status verified: wraps full CORVETTE SCOUT // 3/6 STAFFED at 1920/4K; viewport sweeps clear except three intentional FLEET ellipses; checklists: passed
Task 'voidfarer-ship-status-legibility' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: document the implicit state machines, add a canonical registry and inspector, unify the action gate, and expose it to REST/CLI

impact_assessment.why: The game encodes 20+ machines in fields and branches with no canonical contract; decision/pirate/customs gates are duplicated across engine, server and CLI; flight actions bypass combat and anomaly (proved: orbit/travel succeed during both), and void_dive bypasses decision/pirate/customs. Agents must reconstruct all of this from scattered fields.
impact_assessment.benefits: One registry documents every machine, state, transition and surface gate; /api/state-machines and `voidfarer state-machines` expose the current state and blockers; one engine action gate consistently blocks combat/anomaly/void/decision/pirate/customs; research switches report discarded progress.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: engine action gating, server GET surface, CLI command, state snapshot; dependency: none; concurrency: inspector reads under the engine lock; state: no save-schema change; regression: existing decision/pirate/customs gates, tests and 60fps cockpit stay intact; stricter combat/anomaly gating may reject previously allowed actions.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests for the gate holes and registry invariants, full suite and project gate, browser smoke test of the cockpit, and a documented deferral for tick-precedence changes.

checkpoints.description: State-machine contract verified: 24-machine registry/inspector, REST+CLI surfaces, combat/anomaly/void flight gates, research message; 21 new tests, 1333 suite, gate 5/5; checklists: passed
Task 'voidfarer-state-machine-contract' completed successfully.
[1/1] Plan: add the four lifecycle machines found during the verification pass (quantum freight, AI captain, megastructure, popup event)

impact_assessment.why: The first registry covered 24 machines; re-checking the models found four real lifecycles still unnamed: TradeOrder delivered on tick, AI captain hired/allied flags, body.restoration_complete, and GameEvent dismissed.
impact_assessment.benefits: The inventory is genuinely complete at 28 machines; the inspector reports in-transit freight, hired/allied captains, restored megastructures and visible popups.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: registry/inspector only; dependency: megastructures catalog import; concurrency: read-only under lock; state: no save change; regression: snapshot grows by four small entries.
impact_assessment.mitigation: New inspector test, 22 state-machine tests, full 1334 suite and the 5/5 gate.

checkpoints.description: Inventory complete: 28 machines, secondary lifecycle inspector test, 22 state-machine tests, 1334 suite, gate 5/5; checklists: passed
Task 'voidfarer-state-machine-completeness' completed successfully.
[1/2] Plan: merge the four blocking encounters behind one normalized payload, resolver, REST pair and CLI command

impact_assessment.why: Decision, pirate, customs and anomaly each have their own model, resolver, route, command and cockpit card. They all mean 'the game is waiting for one choice', but the player/agent must learn four separate surfaces on top of 71 CLI commands and 148 routes.
impact_assessment.benefits: One encounter payload with costs and disabled reasons; one POST route and one `encounter` command; one cockpit card; effects, saves and legacy routes unchanged.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: REST/CLI/state snapshot; dependency: none; concurrency: resolve checks then delegates to the existing lock-protected resolvers; state: no save-schema change; regression: legacy routes and commands must keep working.
impact_assessment.mitigation: 14 facade tests, blocked-allowlist tests, full suite, browser play and the 5/5 gate; legacy paths stay wired.

checkpoints.description: Unified encounter backend verified: normalized payload/resolver, GET+POST routes, blocked allowlist, CLI, 14 tests, 1348 suite, gate 5/5; checklists: passed
Task 'voidfarer-encounter-merge' completed successfully.
[1/2] Plan: merge upgrades, structural modules, weapons and hulls behind one fitting report, installer, REST pair and CLI command

impact_assessment.why: Four ship-hardware catalogs use four CLI verbs, four route families and two cockpit tabs for one player question; costs, slot rules and availability are learned four times.
impact_assessment.benefits: One fitting report with installed/available rows, costs, slot occupancy and affordability; one install/remove entry point; one REST pair; one CLI verb; legacy commands/routes unchanged.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: REST/CLI/snapshot and the fitting report; dependency: upgrades/shipmods/weapons catalogs; concurrency: report reads state, install delegates to lock-protected engine methods; state: no save change; regression: every legacy fitting command and route must keep working.
impact_assessment.mitigation: 11 facade tests, full suite, gate, and a cockpit module move with its own UI task.

checkpoints.description: Fitting facade verified: report/summary, four install paths, upgrade/module removal, REST+CLI, 11 tests, 1359 suite, gate 5/5; checklists: passed
